environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). The application is directly exposed on port 8080 with no intermediary filtering. Security groups allow inbound traffic on port 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer firewall or request inspection is configured. The SQLite database contains production user data including emails and role assignments.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB in TCP passthrough mode on port 8080
